title: Pen tool: click-to-add bezier anchor points for precise path drawing
description: Add a Pen tool (P key) to the authoring UI. Unlike the pencil (freehand), the pen tool lets users click to place anchor points and create precise bezier paths. (1) Click = add a sharp corner anchor; (2) Click+drag = add a smooth curve anchor with control handles; (3) Double-click = close path / end path; (4) Escape = discard in-progress path; (5) Click on start point = close path. The path is built up as a series of PathSegment objects (matching the existing path data model). On path completion, call onShapeEnd to add the shape to the active layer. Wire in StageArea.tsx: when activeTool==='pen', handle mouse events for the pen interaction. Add a pen cursor. Show in-progress path as a canvas overlay while drawing. Wire P key shortcut in Shell.tsx to set activeTool='pen'. The pen tool should produce shapes with the current fill/stroke colors. See docs/03-drawing-tools.md for drawing model.
